commit.message:
[skills] standardize EAS CLI invocations and simplify triggers (#223)

Consolidate the mechanical EAS CLI invocation updates in one stack
layer: 125 direct substitutions across 15 existing skill, reference, and
agent metadata files now use `npx --yes eas-cli@latest` in place of bare
`eas` or `npx eas-cli@latest`. This extends the existing Hosting, dev
client, and workflow examples to app stores, Update, Update Insights,
Observe, and App Clip. Remove global EAS CLI installation instructions
from the app-store quick start and Update Insights prerequisites; check
the current account before browser sign-in. The layer also simplifies
skill triggers and keeps development client signing and distribution
tied to the requested project and build.

## Test plan

- `bun test scripts` — 37 passed on the integrated #224 branch.
- `bun scripts/check-skill-limits.ts`, `bun
scripts/check-overview-routing.ts`, and `bun
scripts/check-plugin-version-bump.ts origin/main` — passed.
- `git diff --check origin/main...HEAD` — passed.
- Confirmed PR #223 contains no global EAS CLI install instruction.

---------

Co-authored-by: Kudo Chien <kudo@KudodeMacBook-Pro.local>
